VXLAN encapsulates Ethernet over UDP/4789. Local VLANs map to a common VNI; ARP, IPv4, and IPv6 traverse the configured underlay. EVPN advertises MAC/IP through the simulated BGP and imports only the matching route target.

Configure the WAN as routed with IPv4 and return routes. For EVPN, enable routing on the switch and configure neighbors on the BGP tab. peerPolicy static uses peers and data-plane learning; peerPolicy evpn requires IMET members imported by RT for traffic and flooding. A /32 loopback decouples the VTEP from the egress interface. The proxyArp option answers locally only for valid EVPN MAC/IP bindings with an IMET member and an underlay path. Probes, gratuitous ARP, and unknown addresses still traverse the network; proxy ARP does not prove that the VM is alive.

The model is limited to local MAC/IP advertisements, RT-based import, and sequence-based mobility. There is no multihoming/ESI, DF election, Type 5 routes, proxy ARP, or binary MP-BGP codec. IMET provides dynamic members for ingress replication in the model.
